module: Locking ("burn" = lock) of an editor Master Spline. A Master Spline has a stack of linked child splines (mesh, assembly, road, tree, decal); locking it also locks all its children: they stay in their tools, uneditable, and their generated content is saved with the level. Unlocking makes everything editable again.
notes: Each lock/unlock is an undoable editor.history action ("Lock Master Spline" / "Unlock Master Spline").
On unlock, the manual changes to the children (mesh and assembly tools only, via eachObjectJumpTable) are recorded in data.records; a later lock (e.g. undo) restores them via splineLock.restore.
Sets spline.isEnabled = not isLocked and calls editor.setDirty().

run.desc: Burn button action: locks the Master Spline at index idx (equivalent to setLocked(idx, true)).

idx.desc: Index of the Master Spline in the list (1-based).

setLocked.desc: Locks or unlocks the Master Spline at index idx, with all its linked children, in a single undoable transaction. Does nothing if the index is invalid.

idx.desc: Index of the Master Spline in the list (1-based).

isLocked.desc: true to lock, false to unlock.
